asf_method: Fixed-reference ASF recomputation: per target, each objective dimension (cds_component, utr5_mrl, utr3_stability, full_mfe_score; all maximized) is min-max normalized with bounds pooled across ALL successful runs of that target (every condition). The shared reference point is the per-dimension best among the target's Serial (bmc_max_rounds=0) best candidates ('utopian-of-Serial'), normalized with the same bounds. ASF distances of every run's best candidate are recomputed against this fixed reference with uniform weights and rho=1e-3 via agent_core.workflows.multi_objective.achievement_scalarizing_function. The stored asf_distance uses a per-run utopian reference and is NOT comparable across conditions (see multi_objective.py ANALYSIS CAVEAT), so it is never used for cross-condition tests.
paired_tests_note: Unit of pairing: target (per-target mean over successful reps). BH-FDR computed over one family of 33 tests (11 metrics x 3 comparisons).
